_comment: As home-deep-loop-linkcheck, with NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B (unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL, MTP built in, Lemonade llama.cpp Vulkan, parallel 1) on Lemonade (port 13305) instead of halogen. Memory is set at load time (ctx_size); Vedetta reads it from /models. Sampling as Lemonade's catalog sets it at launch: temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, no top_k. Run with bench.py --mode deep.
